description:
The AWS Analytics Engineering (AAE) organization is the analytics backbone of AWS. We build and operate the data platform that powers business decisions across more than 250 AWS services. Every insight surfaced to AWS product leadership, from service adoption trends to revenue drivers, flows through systems our team designs, builds, and maintains.

We operate at massive scale, processing petabytes of data daily through thousands of jobs spanning transformations, reporting queries, ingestions, and infrastructure management scripts. Our engineers work directly with source systems to procure data, convert it into structured formats, build large-scale processing pipelines, design analytical data models, and maintain infrastructure with the highest security and compliance standards.

We are seeking a Data Engineer II to join our team. You will own data pipelines and analytical models within one or more data domains, improve the quality and accessibility of high-value datasets, and contribute to architectural improvements that support how AWS leaders make decisions. You will partner with service teams across AWS to clarify data requirements, implement data contracts and ingestion flows, and deliver scalable analytical datasets for customers across the organization.

The ideal candidate is an experienced data engineer who independently delivers reliable solutions to difficult data problems and seeks direction when broader architectural decisions require it. You have strong SQL, ETL, data modeling, and programming skills, with experience using cloud-based data services such as AWS EMR, Glue, Redshift, and Lambda. Experience applying AI/ML technologies, including LLMs and agentic workflows, to data engineering use cases is valuable. You are comfortable working through loosely defined requirements, collaborating with technical and business partners, and building secure, maintainable data solutions at AWS scale.



Key job responsibilities
- Design, build, and optimize logical data models and data pipelines for difficult datasets in the team's area. Translate loosely defined business requirements into secure, testable, maintainable, and efficient data solutions.
- Own the quality and operational health of assigned datasets and pipelines. Establish monitoring, alarming, runbooks, data validation, and SLA tracking, and participate in the team's on-call rotation.
- Contribute to data architecture and design decisions for the solutions you own. Apply established patterns and make sound trade-offs among delivery speed, scalability, maintainability, security, and cost.
- Build and operate infrastructure for assigned data solutions using automation and team standards. Anticipate access and processing needs, troubleshoot failures, and remove recurring operational bottlenecks.
- Partner with AWS service teams and analytics customers to clarify requirements, define data contracts, resolve data quality issues, and improve self-service access to trusted datasets.
- Own projects or substantial project components from design through launch and ongoing operations. Identify dependencies and risks, coordinate with peers and partner teams, and escalate when broader alignment or architectural guidance is needed.
- Apply data engineering best practices for code quality, testing, documentation, naming, dependency management, data certification, security, and auditability.
- Participate in code reviews and design discussions, provide constructive technical feedback, share knowledge, and begin mentoring less-experienced engineers.
- Identify limitations in existing data solutions and implement or propose improvements. Contribute to reusable patterns and larger architectural initiatives led by senior engineers.
- Explore and apply AI/ML technologies, including LLMs and agentic workflows, to improve data discovery, pipeline development, operational support, and analytics productivity.

description:
Fauna Robotics is building capable, safe, and delightful robots for everyday life. We are hiring a Software Development Engineer to build the data pipelines behind our robot learning models. In this role, you will turn recordings from robots and simulation into usable data for scientists across many domains.

The ideal candidate has built and operated production data systems. They create systems that are easy to use for engineers and scientists: results that reproduce, jobs that are safe to re-run, and failures that are easy to diagnose. They can improve a system that people already depend on without disrupting them. They professionalize research workflows, turning one-off scripts into shared tools the whole team can use.

Key job responsibilities
- Build and operate software services that ingest, process, and prepare multimodal robot data for model training

- Develop tools that let scientists add their own data processing steps and run them at scale

- Make data fast and reliable to load into training jobs

- Add monitoring so that failures and gaps in the data reach an owner quickly

- Take part in on-call for cloud services across the team

- Protect sensitive data with access controls and auditing

About the team
Fauna Robotics, an Amazon company, is building capable, safe, and genuinely delightful robots for everyday life. Our goal is simple: make robots people actually want to live and interact with in everyday human spaces.
We believe that future won’t arrive until building for robotics becomes far more accessible. Today, too much effort is spent reinventing the fundamentals. We’re changing that by developing tightly integrated hardware and software systems that make it faster, safer, and more intuitive to create real-world robotic products.
Our work spans the full stack: mechanical design, control systems, dynamic modeling, and intelligent software. The focus is not just functionality, but experience. We’re building robots that feel responsive, expressive, and genuinely useful.
At Fauna, you’ll work at the frontier of this space, helping define how robots move, manipulate, and interact with people in natural environments. It’s an opportunity to solve hard problems across hardware and software with a team focused on making robotics accessible and joyful to build.
If you care about making robotics real for everyone and building systems that are as delightful as they are capable, we’re interested in hearing from you.

Key job responsibilities
Design, develop, and maintain ETL pipelines to ingest data into the data warehouse and data lake
Create and optimize logical data models that drive physical design for the Infrastructure Operations organization

Build scalable, efficient, and maintainable data solutions that support business intelligence needs

We turn raw operational signals into trusted data products, dashboards, and APIs that technicians, site leaders, and executives use every day to keep infrastructure safe, reliable, and efficient. You'll work closely with fellow engineers, and operations partners around the world to solve real-world problems at massive scale. We value ownership, curiosity, and learning from each other. description:
Are you passionate about building data pipelines and turning raw information into actionable insights? Do you enjoy designing solutions that help teams make smarter, faster decisions? As a Data Engineer I at Amazon, you will build and maintain data solutions that power critical business decisions across the organization. You will work with large-scale datasets, design efficient data models, and create automated pipelines that process millions of data points. This is an opportunity to grow your technical skills while collaborating with analysts, data scientists, and engineers who rely on your work to unlock the value hidden in data. If you are curious, resourceful, and energized by solving real problems with data, we want to hear from you.

Key job responsibilities
- Design, implement, and maintain data pipelines and ETL workflows that ingest, transform, and persist data from multiple sources at scale.
- Create and optimize physical data models, applying best practices in schema design, partitioning, indexing, and query performance tuning to ensure reliable and efficient data access.
- Write secure, testable, and well-documented code using scripting and query languages such as SQL, Python, or Scala to automate data processing and support analytical workloads.
- Collaborate with business analysts, data scientists, and engineering partners to understand requirements and translate them into technical solutions that meet business needs.
- Monitor data pipelines for operational issues, troubleshoot root causes, and resolve defects to maintain data integrity and system reliability.

A day in the life
You will start your day reviewing pipeline health dashboards and addressing any data quality alerts. From there, you might refine a data model to support a new reporting requirement, write and test ETL code, or pair with a teammate to review a schema change. Expect regular conversations with analysts and data scientists who depend on your pipelines, helping you stay connected to the business impact of your work. You will also participate in design discussions and code reviews, continuously sharpening your skills in a collaborative engineering environment.

About the team
Amazon's Global Logistics (GL) Exports team supports Amazon's vision of offering customers worldwide cross-border product selection at competitive prices. We build the data infrastructure and analytics that power smart, data-driven decisions for customers, sellers, and vendors navigating international trade and logistics. Our work directly shapes Amazon's ability to scale globally and deliver innovative e-commerce solutions.

We value collaboration, continuous learning, and operational excellence. You'll join a group of engineers who support each other through mentorship, knowledge sharing, and constructive feedback. We're investing in scalable, well-architected data solutions, and we're excited to welcome team members who want to grow their careers while making a meaningful impact on how Amazon uses data to connect the world.

description:
Do you want to build the data foundation for a fleet of batteries, from the lab to the field? This role sits where data engineering, software, and the physical sciences meet. You will stand up, nearly from scratch, the pipelines and platforms that carry sensor, test lab, fleet, and model training data across the organization. Every model, algorithm, and design decision we make depends on that data being complete, trustworthy, and easy to use. You will work side by side with scientists, software engineers, and cell experts, and as an early hire you will define how data works across the organization.

This role can be based in Boston, Irvine, Sunnyvale, or Seattle, and involves occasional domestic travel, up to 10% of the time.


Key job responsibilities
• Design and build the data architecture for sensor, test lab, fleet, and model training data, from ingestion through storage and access.
• Build scalable, reliable pipelines for high-volume time-series data from devices and test equipment.
• Own data quality, lineage, and governance, so scientists and engineers can trust and reproduce their results.
• Work with scientists and engineers across algorithms, ML, cell modeling, and testing to understand their needs and deliver data in forms they can use.
• Set data engineering standards and tools, and help grow the data engineering function as the organization expands.


A day in the life
Your week moves between design, code, and the people who use your data. One day you might be designing how years of cycling data from multiple labs land in one consistent schema, and the next tracking down why a field data feed is dropping samples. You could be working with a scientist on the data a new model needs, or reviewing a pipeline design with the software team. Some of the best days will be when a scientist finds an aging signal in data your pipeline made usable. Your work determines how fast everyone else can learn.

About the team
We are building Amazon's energy storage capability, providing power for advanced technologies while contributing to a stable grid. Our product is highly connected, yet secure and resilient by design. We own it end to end, from software, ML, and controls through system design to cell selection and supply, and on to a safety-certified product in the field. The organization operates like a startup inside Amazon: small, fast-moving, and accountable for our decisions. We work across hardware, software, and science, with suppliers and partners worldwide, and with Amazon infrastructure, procurement, legal, and finance.
The organization is at an early stage and growing quickly. You will be among the first hires in your function, so you will help shape how we design, build, certify, and ship, with a direct line of sight to the product and business decisions your work informs. This is a dynamic role that will regularly present new challenges as the product and organization evolve.

description:
Do you want a role with deep meaning and the ability to make a major impact? As part of Intelligent Talent Acquisition (ITA), you'll have the opportunity to reinvent the hiring process and deliver unprecedented scale, sophistication, and accuracy for Amazon Talent Acquisition operations. ITA is an industry-leading people science and technology organization made up of scientists, engineers, analysts, product professionals and more, all with the shared goal of connecting the right people to the right jobs in a way that is fair and precise. Last year we delivered over 6 million online candidate assessments, and helped Amazon deliver billions of packages around the world by making it possible to hire hundreds of thousands of workers in the right quantity, at the right location and at exactly the right time. You’ll work on state-of-the-art research, advanced software tools, new AI systems, and machine learning algorithms, leveraging Amazon's in-house tech stack to bring innovative solutions to life. Join ITA in using technologies to transform the hiring landscape and make a meaningful difference in people's lives. Together, we can solve the world's toughest hiring problems.

Data team builds the foundational data infrastructure and analytics tools that power Amazon's hiring decisions. We create secure, scalable solutions that enable teams across ITA to access and analyze recruitment data effectively while maintaining data integrity.

Key job responsibilities
• Design and implement scalable, secure data pipelines and infrastructure using AWS technologies and big data tools
• Build and maintain high-performance ETL processes that handle large-scale, complex datasets
• Architect end-to-end analytical solutions that are highly available, stable, and cost-effective
• Transform raw data into actionable insights through effective data modeling and integration
• Implement best practices in data system creation, data integrity, and documentation
• Proactively identify opportunities for process improvement and automation
• Partner with business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into technical solutions

A day in the life
Within ITA, the Data team delivers high-quality recruiting data, reusable tools, and analytics reporting to Amazon Talent Acquisition customers. The Data team is the engine behind ITA’s success, creating pathways to information upon which all of the organization’s products are built and enabling Amazon to make correct hiring decisions a million times over.
